focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on book/CD spines
Structural integrity of shelf supports and vertical frames
Boundary separation between individual items on shelves
Realism of the small electronic device
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the spines. In real photos, even blurry text usually maintains linear alignment and character spacing. AI often generates 'wavy' or 'melting' text lines. Also, verify if the electronic device on the right has a logical physical form (lens, screen, stand) or if it is a generic blob. Check the bottom-left corner for any geometric inconsistencies where the furniture meets the wall/floor.
image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a light-colored wooden bookcase filled with books and media cases. The bookcase features multiple horizontal shelves. The left section contains rows of what appear to be CD or DVD cases with colorful spines. The right section contains hardcover and paperback books, some stacked horizontally. A small white electronic device (possibly a baby monitor or camera) sits on one of the right-hand shelves. The wood grain is visible, and the lighting appears natural, casting soft shadows.

expert_testimonies.reason: To confirm the primary object classification and distinguish between real photography and AI generation based on texture statistics.
To rigorously analyze the legibility and coherence of the text on the media spines, which is a common failure point in AI images.
To check for fusion artifacts between adjacent books/cases and ensure shelf edges are sharp and physically distinct from the background.
To assess global lighting consistency and detect subtle warping or perspective errors in the furniture structure.
